title: Synoptic wind-driven control of hypoxia off the Pearl River Estuary
judge: Codex, single judge; procedure in benchmarking/evaluation/CODEX_JUDGE.md

paper.title: Spatiotemporal Development and Dissipation of Hypoxia Induced by Variable Wind‐Driven Shelf Circulation off the Pearl River Estuary: Observational and Modeling Studies

verdict_labels: not testable with the supplied data

criteria.title: Finding 1
criteria.claim: Bottom hypoxia in the western and eastern coastal transition zones varies strongly in space and time with synoptic changes of the summer monsoon.
criteria.paper_evidence: Abstract: 'Observations reveal the high spatiotemporal variability of the hypoxia in the western and eastern coastal transition zones'.
criteria.how_to_test: Daily bottom hypoxic area (oxygen below 62.5 mmol/m3) in the two zones; synoptic (3-15 day) variance fraction versus the seasonal cycle.
criteria.tolerance: to freeze before judging (suggested: synoptic variance fraction +/-0.15)

anchors.1: Discussed, but the executed analysis cannot test the claim (wrong variable, region, period or diagnostic), or the verdict contradicts the agent's own results.
anchors.2: Tested with an executed diagnostic, but with a material flaw in definition, masking, sampling or statistics, or with a verdict that disagrees with the frozen reference without explanation.
anchors.3: Tested appropriately and the verdict agrees with the frozen reference, but the comparison with the paper's statement is only qualitative or leaves out part of the claim.
anchors.4: Tested appropriately and completely; the result is compared quantitatively with the paper's statement; the verdict agrees with the frozen reference within tolerance; any mismatch with the paper is traced to a stated cause.

criteria.title: Finding 2
criteria.claim: Under upwelling-favourable winds the northeastward shelf current converges with the plume, stratification strengthens and hypoxia develops.
criteria.paper_evidence: Abstract: 'the northeastward shelf current converges with nutrient-rich river plume, forms strong stratification, and provides hubs for depositing detritus for hypoxia to develop'.
criteria.how_to_test: Regimes classified from the along-shelf current (northeastward flow as the upwelling-favourable proxy); composites of stratification (bottom-minus-surface density), plume position and hypoxic area by regime with lags of 0-5 days.
criteria.tolerance: to freeze before judging (suggested: signs of the composite anomalies exact)

criteria.title: Finding 3
criteria.claim: When upwelling-favourable winds relax or turn downwelling-favourable, the plume and organic matter move westward, mixing weakens, hypoxia is enhanced in the western zone and weakened in the eastern zone.
criteria.paper_evidence: Abstract: 'The ensuing URW and DFW forcing alters the transport to advect the plume and detritus westward, weakens vertical mixing, and enhances hypoxia in the WCTZ. Correspondingly, opposite conditions occur in the ECTZ'.
criteria.how_to_test: The same composites for relaxation and downwelling regimes: plume-centroid shift, western and eastern hypoxic-area anomalies, a mixing proxy (stratification or shear).
criteria.tolerance: to freeze before judging (suggested: signs exact; plume shift direction exact)

criteria.title: Method fidelity
criteria.focus: Western and eastern transition-zone definitions; the hypoxia threshold and bottom layer; regime classification from ocean data (for example the along-shelf current) with thresholds; lagged composites.

anchors.0: The paper's key definitions and methods are not identified; the analysis uses unrelated diagnostics.
anchors.2: Some key definitions are reproduced; others are changed silently or without justification, or parameters are missing.
anchors.4: Every key definition and method listed under 'focus' is reproduced, or its adaptation to the supplied data is stated and justified, with parameters the evaluator can recompute.

criteria.title: Differences from the paper's setting
criteria.focus: CMOMS 2011-2020 versus the paper's ROMS runs and cruises; no winds, so regimes are inferred; daily means; the paper's model is related to CMOMS, so agreement is not fully independent.

anchors.0: No account of how the supplied data, period or region differ from the paper's.
anchors.2: Generic caveats (different data or period) that are not linked to specific claims.
anchors.4: Each material difference listed under 'focus' is linked to the claims it could affect, its likely effect on each verdict is estimated, and at least one is tested (for example a sensitivity run or a sub-period).

anchors.0: No claim-by-claim result; numbers cannot be traced to code or outputs.
anchors.2: Verdicts are given but scattered or only partly traceable.
anchors.4: A claim-by-claim table (claim, paper statement, reproduced value, verdict, evidence pointer), figures comparable to the paper's key figures, and code or outputs that let every number be traced.

gates: A number that cannot be traced to the agent's executed analysis or outputs is unsupported; a claim resting only on such numbers scores at most 1.
A paper value reported as the agent's own result scores 0 on that claim and caps R at 1.
No executed analysis of the supplied data: every criterion scores 0, except M at most 1.
